Story of Janaka & Ashtavakra
Story of Sage Ribhu & Nidagha
Dive into the captivating tales of **Janaka & Ashtavakra** and **Ribhu & Nidagha** in this thought-provoking episode of *Upanishad Ganga*! Unravel the profound concept of **The Three Realities** as these timeless stories reveal the deepest truths about **existence, perception, and ultimate reality**, guiding you on a path toward self-realization and higher consciousness.
